_about: Reference facts for the 10 MIMIC-IV Replay trials (EmulatRx Table 2, acute care). Compiled 2026-10-24 from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 records (cached), PubMed E-utilities abstracts, and the EmulatRx paper main text (Li et al., Nat Commun 17:5501, 2026). verification: 'verified' = source states it directly (publication cites the NCT ID, or the registry posts it); 'probable' = matched on sponsor, design and sample size but the PubMed record does not cite the NCT ID; 'not_found' = searched and nothing found; 'not_reported' = the source does not give it. Values marked computed=true were derived by us from reported counts (Wald 95% CI) and are not reported by the authors. See replay_trials.md for the readable table and caveats.

searched.pubmed: esearch term '<NCT>[si] OR <NCT>[tiab]' for every trial, plus title/design keyword searches for trials without a hit (2026-10-24)
searched.emulatrx: main text only (Case 1-3 showcases and Table 2); Supplementary Information not checked

trials.registry_primary_outcome: Composite of rehospitalization due to heart failure and all-cause mortality, randomization to day 30 (co-primary with dyspnea at 6 h and 24 h)

publication.citation: O'Connor CM et al. N Engl J Med 2011;365(1):32-43

published_primary_result.measure: risk difference (percentage points), 30-day HF rehospitalization or death

emulatrx.measure: hazard ratio, composite rehospitalization and all-cause mortality

trials.notes: Different effect scales (RD vs HR). RCT null; emulation reports a significant benefit.

publication.citation: Dominguez-Rodriguez A et al. Eur J Heart Fail 2022;24(10):1953-1962
publication.match_note: PubMed record does not carry the NCT ID; the title names the MIMO trial, which is the registry title

published_primary_result.measure: risk ratio, in-hospital all-cause mortality, midazolam vs morphine

trials.notes: Stopped early at interim analysis (111 randomized).

publication.citation: Lyu QQ et al. Crit Care 2022;26(1):295

published_primary_result.ci_note: no effect estimate or CI in the abstract; full text (PMC9520942) not checked

trials.notes: Upstream EmulatRx cached its Trialist parse for this trial (third_party/emulatrx).

trials.registry_primary_outcome: In-hospital or 28-day mortality rate, 28 days or discharge (whichever comes first)
trials.notes: Last known status 'not yet recruiting' (verified 2019-10); enrollment 80 estimated. The registry intervention is a hydrocortisone + thiamine + ascorbic acid bundle; EmulatRx describes the emulation as hydrocortisone therapy. No RCT result exists to replay against.

trials.registry_primary_outcome: In-hospital mortality, ICU admission to death during hospital care, up to 3 months

registry_result.multivariable_note: a second analysis is posted as 'Odds Ratio, log' 3.4 (95% CI 2.0-6.1), logistic regression; the label is ambiguous (likely an adjusted OR, not a log-OR) and is not used

emulatrx.ci_note: CI not reported in main text

trials.notes: Not a randomized trial. The registry's crude association (RRT, higher mortality) points the opposite way to the EmulatRx estimate (RRT, lower mortality); the crude OR is confounded by indication, so this is not a like-for-like comparison.

computed_result.measure: risk difference (percentage points), counts 11/40 vs 14/40 derived from reported percentages

trials.notes: Registry primary (14-day hospital survival) differs from the published primary (28-day mortality). Terminated after the midterm analysis.

trials.registry_primary_outcome: Death from any cause at 14, 28, 90 and 365 days

publication.search_note: PubMed by NCT returns only a Cochrane review that cites the trial (PMID 36416787)

trials.notes: Registry eligibility text is irregular (merged clauses); expect parsing disagreement.

trials.registry_primary_outcome: Mortality and risk of death by severe sepsis/shock and MODS, 28 days

publication.match_note: 600 patients, University of Athens group, IV clarithromycin vs placebo, 28-day mortality; PubMed record does not cite NCT01223690. Confirm in the full text.
